new_findings.title: ModelValidationTests.LeaderboardItem_StoresEntryCorrectly is a smoke test of a property setter
new_findings.rule_violated: Testing: tests must exercise business logic, not language-level property assignment
new_findings.remediation: Remove or replace with a test of LeaderboardItem ordering/sorting logic.

new_findings.title: LinearSpacing_CalculateScoresFromStrengths_VariedStrengths uses fuzzy assertions
new_findings.evidence_snippet:
Assert.True(scores["A"] > 90.0, "Highest strength should get near max");
Assert.True(scores["C"] < 10.0, "Lowest strength should get near min");
new_findings.rule_violated: Testing: assertions should use exact expected values when the algorithm is deterministic (Math.Round output is predictable)
new_findings.remediation: Compute expected values manually: strengths {3.0,1.0,0.0} with maxScore=100 → normalized {1.0, 0.333, 0.0} → {100, 33.33, 0}. Assert exact.

new_findings.title: BackupService version mismatch test omits verification of schema version key removal
new_findings.evidence_snippet:
mockStorage.Verify(s => s.RemoveItemAsync("db_backup"), Times.Once);
// Missing: Verify RemoveItemAsync("db_schema_version")
new_findings.rule_violated: Testing: verify all side effects of the method under test

new_findings.title: BackupService mocks ILogger but never verifies log calls on warning/error paths
new_findings.evidence_snippet: // _mockLogger instantiated but never verified via Verify or VerifyLog
new_findings.rule_violated: Testing: mocks that represent observed side effects (logging) should be verified
new_findings.remediation: Use Mock.Of<ILogger>() (no verification needed) since logging is not the subject, or add Verify calls for LogWarning/LogError paths.

new_findings.title: 3 of 5 CalculateScoresFromStrengths tests use ordinal-only assertions where exact values are available
new_findings.rule_violated: Testing: prefer exact value assertions over ordinal comparisons when output is deterministic
new_findings.remediation: Replace ordinal assertions with exact Math.Round output values in all three tests.

new_findings.title: Percentile and DefinedInterval CalculateScoresFromStrengths tests duplicate LinearSpacing coverage without covering unique paths
new_findings.rule_violated: Testing: test coverage should target missing edge cases rather than re-testing the same scenario across different strategies
new_findings.remediation: Add single-entry test for Percentile, empty-dict test for Percentile, and same-strength test for DefinedInterval.
